title: All The Tech
description: A modpack that mixes a bunch of tech while still somehow working, wow
body:
All The Tech is a 1.21.1 NeoForge modpack that contains various Create, Applied Energistics 2, Mekanism, CC: Tweaked, some of their addons and various more other QOL mods, also includes mods like exposure, sophisticated backpacks/storage and chipped

You can make a lot of stuff with this modpack, some of which are: Karpowership, ballistic missiles, anti-air, air, a fusion reactor floating at build limit sending power down with a very long wire, IFF system, and last but not least, all of the above
The only limit to what you can make with this are your imagination, your skillset and the category of the modpack

(Don't add sodium addons it got angry and bit me)
